claims.statement: Polish PV installers are currently paid for completed installations, while a valid grid notification requires specified forms and technical attachments; omissions can delay the customer handover and final invoice.

The founder has an existing, legally usable operating relationship with a seven-person family renewable-installation company that can serve as a nonexclusive design partner; no customer data rights are assumed.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Owner or sales manager of a small renewable-energy installer
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: The product protects quote margin and produces an auditable handover pack across inverter, battery and OSD variants; generic CRM quoting does not encode these checks.
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own contracts with subscribing installers; the family installer retains its own end-customer relationships.
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Begin with the family installer as a design partner, then sell asynchronously through Polish installer associations, wholesalers and targeted email.

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Assumption: 1,200 PLN per installer initially, falling below 700 PLN with channel referrals; unknown until 20 sales conversations.
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Monthly prepaid subscription; implementation fee collected before configuration.
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 78-88% after hosting and support at 30-100 customers.
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Assumption: 3-6 onboarding hours plus 1 hour monthly support per customer initially.
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Budget 3,000 PLN monthly at scale for legal, accounting, security and liability cover.
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Per-branch subscription plus setup and optional per-document overage.
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: LLM/OCR, document storage and occasional implementation support; estimated 80-220 PLN per account monthly.

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Polish solar CRMs may add checklist templates; defend with continuously maintained equipment/OSD validation and margin benchmarks.
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Installer receives payment for an accepted installation; rework, underquoted components or an incomplete OSD pack reduces margin or delays collection.
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Two recent margin misses, rejected paperwork or hiring a new estimator.
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual renewal after measured reduction in quote errors and handover delay.

contrary_evidence: For micro-installations at or below the property's connection capacity, the process is relatively streamlined, limiting willingness to pay for paperwork alone.
The family relationship provides access for validation but does not establish software demand or transferable customer rights.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Existing informal family operating relationship permitting voluntary workflow observation and synthetic or customer-consented examples; proposed software subscription rights remain unsigned.
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Use synthetic cases and recruit independent installers through paid discovery interviews; do not use family customer records without consent.
critical_control_point.current_owner: The family company owns its workflows and customer relationships; each OSD controls its forms and acceptance process.
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own contracts with subscribing installers; the family installer retains its own end-customer relationships.
critical_control_point.duration: Existing relationship is ongoing with no fixed contractual duration.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Legally usable family-company relationship for voluntary process access, excluding confidential employer resources and ungranted customer data.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder would control the rules engine and installer subscriptions if built and sold.
critical_control_point.renewal: Operating access can continue by mutual consent; customer subscriptions would renew annually if signed.
critical_control_point.subject: Installer quoting and handover workflow access

economics.acquisition_route: Validate on 50 historical or synthetic quotes with permission, charge a 3,000-6,000 PLN setup and 900-1,800 PLN monthly per branch, then partner with wholesalers.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 250 customers at 1,300 PLN monthly creates 3.9M PLN ARR; at 25% owner earnings plus a conservative 4x recurring-revenue value, an 80% stake could exceed 5M PLN in years 5-7. Unknowns are churn and channel CAC; do not double-count retained earnings.
economics.founder_time: 12-18 hours weekly until repeatable onboarding; compatible with the 5-hour daily ceiling.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Software subscription less OCR/LLM, hosting and direct support; target 80% before sales and overhead.
economics.payback: Target customer payback within one avoided 4,000-10,000 PLN margin error; founder CAC payback under four months.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Recurring quote checks, equipment updates and OSD handover packs create weekly use.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned anonymized error taxonomy and equipment-rule library improve checks without relying on confidential data.
fingerprint.customer: Polish PV, heat-pump and battery installers with 5-50 staff.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Design-partner proof followed by wholesaler and installer-association referrals.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Installer owner pays a subscription around the accepted-installation invoice event.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A rejected grid pack, margin miss or estimator onboarding.

founder_fit: Part-time asynchronous sales and product delivery
risks: Small installers may tolerate spreadsheet-based quoting.
Equipment and OSD rules require continuous maintenance.
Bad validation could create liability; human approval must remain explicit.

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: installer quote validation and handover subscription
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: independent installers adopting a new quote gate

structure.control_point: Rules engine inserted before quote approval and final handover
structure.critical_dependency: Installer adoption and permissioned workflow examples

thesis: Use replaceable family-company workflow access to prove that an automated quote and handover gate prevents losses, then sell the maintained rules layer to Polish installation SMEs.
title: PV Installer Quote-Margin Guard
uncertainties: Frequency and value of preventable errors
Willingness to pay by installer size
Ability to maintain equipment and OSD rule coverage
